From the diagram, we see that $f(x)$ has roots ${x}_{1}=4$ and ${x}_{2,3}=\pm 3\text{i}.$ Additionally, we're given that the coefficient of the cubic term is $a=1.$ Therefore, we can write the polynomial as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}f(x) & =a(x-{x}_{1})(x-{x}_{2})(x-{x}_{3}) \\  & =1(x-4)(x-3\text{i})(x-(-3\text{i})) \\  & =(x-4)(x-3\text{i})(x+3\text{i})\end{aligned}
$$

Expanding the parentheses, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}(x-4)(x-3\text{i})(x+3\text{i}) & = \\ (x-4)({x}^{2}-x(-3\text{i})-x(3\text{i})+(3\text{i})(-3\text{i})) & = \\ (x-4)({x}^{2}+9) & = \\ {x}^{3}+9x-4{x}^{2}-36 & = \\ {x}^{3}-4{x}^{2}+9x-36 & .\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $f(x)={x}^{3}-4{x}^{2}+9x-36.$
